label: PF Backlog 89
title: Backend: git history/PR/tags/branches API (check-ins with date/time/#/PR/details, tags, branches, merges)
body: Expose the VCS history for a project so the dashboard can track every check-in. Source: core/vcs.py VCSManager (checkins() with PR extraction; current_branch, has_remote, has_conflicts, ensure_develop, tag) + core/git_manager.py (list_branches, worktrees). Add: GET /api/v1/git/history?project= [commits: hash, short#, date, time, author, subject/details, branch, PR#, files, +/-]; GET /api/v1/git/tags; GET /api/v1/git/branches [name, behind/ahead vs develop/main]; GET /api/v1/git/merges [branch -> develop/main events]. Refs: BI-0086 (repo config/status).

dashboard_impact.reason: git check-ins / project creation surface exists
